comparison.objective: Refit a sprung delta-printer arm pair onto an effector's ball-stud pair.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold two sockets spread against spring force while the other hand positions the loose effector.
comparison.success_condition: Both sockets seated on one stud pair at the specified width, effector flat, both grippers clear, stable for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Tests bimanual elastic spreading and snap-on assembly, not destructive tang removal, hammer-force regulation, or loose-fragment recovery.
